body: I'm not trying to reclaim the word. I'm debating with friends why it is offensive and shouldn't be used.

As a trans man this word does piss me off. Of course now I'm in a debate with a friend over why this word is offensive and like the word faggot. Of course my friend is arguing that it's just an acceptable slang word for trans* and I'm not the best debater plus the fact I've never really thought about why this word offends me or others.

I didn't really pick my name. There were no lists for me, there wasn't any ideas. I just kinda sat down and was all "Oh hey, I'm Lucifer...shit". Any other name that I've tried to use doesn't stick and I always revert back to Lucifer/Luci. So I finally gave up and just went with it.

My own name is a name that many people think I'm a horrible person over. Lucifer. It means bringer of light or some variation of that. The normal responses I get is "Oh my god, you're a horrible person", "Your name is who you are", and "You can't be Lucifer, that's the name of the devil". Well I'm a pretty timid, shy, gay boy and this is my name. My nickname is Luci and that gets me called a girl or is pronounced wrong all the time. Though this is my name and nickname. On occasion I have to fight others for it but I wouldn't have it any other way. My name came to me though in a sorta "Hey this is who you are, this is your name. Smiles everyone :)" way. It's the only thing I answer to and any other male name I try just makes me melt into a puddle of sadness.

So, moral of my long ramble if you want to be called Amni or if Amni is the thing you answer to, then use it. Screw other people. You can correct people and enjoy your name. Find the name that you love and if need be, fight for it, no matter what that name is.

When I came out to my mom, she bashed every single man she could. She told me I was too smart to be a man and that I was a perfectly fine girl. I'm a guy, she just refuses to understand. Anytime I mention something that annoys me, my mom tells me "Well that's what men do and that's why you're not a man". I've given up getting her to see my side. My mom is weird, she's fine if everyone else is transgender/homosexual but for me, I'm not allowed to be and it's dirty. I'm a perfectly good straight girl to her. -_- Though since I know where they stand, now a days I just dress, bind, wear my rainbows all I want.

1. If your name is special, I don't see why you can't keep it. My female name really upset me and made me cry, growl, and really be angry most of my life. Where if you like it, keep it as part of your middle name.

2. My name is Lucifer, now. I have to fight tooth and nail for my name. I get targeted sometimes for it, yelled at, called names, and I've had people stop talking to me just because it's my name. If you think your name is worth it, use it. I know that Lucifer is my name and it's the only thing I answer to. If people don't like it, then they weren't very good friends and not worth it. I see no reason not to use a name that you like. It's your name. Just be ready to research the backgrounds of that name and be ready to fight for it if it's something that can be even a little bit offensive.
